verdict.rationale: a-Shell has an HTTP surface, an optional built-in relay server with POST /run, so a machine-readable spec is a fair question here. The evidence states there is no OpenAPI document: the relay endpoint is described only in README prose. Probes for openapi.json, swagger.json and .well-known paths all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
